reuse.why: Adds one shared isDailyWeekendSkip predicate used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template, and keeps getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the moving case; schedule-template delegates the skip to getNextDate.

duplication.why: The repeated getNextDate/adjust blocks in schedule-template are folded into two local closures; only the weekend filter itself is written twice (getNextDate and getUpcomingDates).

placement.why: Predicate and lookahead live in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing weekend helper; consumers only call into it.

scope.why: All edits cover the three weekend paths plus tests and a release note; the schedule-template loop restructuring is related but slightly beyond the minimum.

maintainability.why: Clear named predicate and constant; minor wrinkle that the skip filter is implemented separately in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates rather than one 'adjusted occurrences' function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all weekend paths go through isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend

disguised_duplication.where: The weekend filter in getUpcomingDates (filter !d.isWeekend) and in getNextDate (find !d.isWeekend) is a small visible repeat, not disguised.

one_place.where: Which schedules skip is decided once in isDailyWeekendSkip (shared/schedules.ts), but the skipping itself is implemented both in getNextDate and in getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts).
